prompt: Create one original premium editorial food illustration for DineSense, a friendly restaurant meal customization iPhone app with warm off-white, tomato red and ink typography. Transparent background, no text, no letters, no logos, no app UI. A beautifully composed wide still life: a white ceramic plate with simple golden pasta, green leaves and roasted tomato pieces, beside two golden breadsticks on a small tomato-red oval side plate and an iced amber drink with a lemon slice in a clear tumbler. A small neatly folded coral-red napkin grounds the arrangement. Contemporary hand-painted gouache with crisp organic contours, gently tactile paper grain, confident simple silhouettes, appetizing warm colors, grown-up and cheerful, not cartoon characters or 3D emoji. Slight overhead three-quarter view. Composition width roughly twice height, all objects fully within frame, transparent margins. The forms remain legible when displayed only 120 points tall on an iPhone. Light subtle natural contact shadows only. This is conceptual unbranded food art, not a photo of a named restaurant dish. Output high quality raster with real alpha transparency.
